findings.current: “The patient I’m looking after is a pretty famous wandering martial artist. When he heard about it, he snorted. He said that no matter how many dark-path figures there were, did they really look like they could stand against the Yangtze One Saber?”
findings.defect: The draft makes the young medical woman the patient’s caretaker. The reflexive 자기가 refers to Sister Hwang, whose story she is recounting, so the caretaker’s identity is changed.
findings.rationale: The surrounding exchange explicitly identifies Sister Hwang as the source of the information; the patient is under Sister Hwang’s care.
findings.replacement: “She said the patient she’s looking after is a pretty famous wandering martial artist, and when he heard the story, he snorted. He said that no matter how many dark-path figures there were, there was no way they could have been a match for the Yangtze One Saber.”
findings.source: 지금 자기가 담당하고 있는 환자가 꽤 유명한 낭인인데, 그분이 그 얘기를 듣고 코웃음을 쳤다는 거예요. 아무리 흑도 놈들의 머릿수가 많아 봤자 장강일도의 상대가 될 것 같냐고.

findings.current: “We were alone. Sister Hwang was telling me for the first time, too.”
findings.defect: The second sentence only says this was the first time Hyang heard the story, failing to answer whether Sister Hwang had already disclosed it to anyone else.
findings.rationale: 제게 처음 말한 establishes that Hyang was Sister Hwang’s first recipient, which is why Physician Song immediately expresses relief.
findings.replacement: “No one else was there—it was just the two of us. And I was the first person Sister Hwang told.”
findings.source: 아무도 없이 단둘이 나눈 이야기에요. 황 언니도 제게 처음 말한 거였고요.

findings.current: “Those dark-path mongrels who committed such heinous crimes will be executed at noon tomorrow. Their severed limbs will be rolling through the streets of Wuhan, and the ground will be soaked in blood.”
findings.defect: The draft omits the two specified methods of execution: beheading and dismemberment by chariots.
findings.rationale: 참수형과 거열형 explicitly names both punishments; reducing them to generic execution loses the physician’s deliberately graphic warning.
findings.replacement: “Those dark-path mongrels who committed such heinous crimes will be put to death at noon tomorrow—some beheaded, others torn apart by chariots. Their severed limbs will be rolling through the streets of Wuhan, and the ground will be soaked in blood.”
findings.source: 저 천인공노할 짓을 벌인 흑도 개잡놈들은 내일 정오에 참수형과 거열형(車裂刑)에 처할 거란다. 무한의 저잣거리에 놈들의 사지가 굴러다니고 핏물이 흥건하겠지.

findings.current: “No, not like that. Repeat after me. Long live His Imperial Majesty the Emperor! Ten thousand years to the City Lord! Ten thousand years to Great Hero Jin Taekyung!”
findings.defect: The draft gives the City Lord and Jin Taekyung ten thousand years, erasing the source’s explicit rank distinction: 만세 for the Emperor and 천세 for the other two.
findings.rationale: The differing acclamations encode imperial hierarchy; assigning 만세 to all three falsely elevates the City Lord and Jin Taekyung to the Emperor’s level.
findings.replacement: “No, not like that. Repeat after me. May His Majesty the Emperor live ten thousand years! A thousand years to the City Lord! A thousand years to Great Hero Jin Taekyung!”
findings.source: 황상 폐하 만세! 성주님 천세! 진태경 대협 천세!

findings.current: *Natural courage? That may be part of it, but there was something else… Yes. He looked familiar with it. Like a battle-hardened veteran who had been through countless wars.*
findings.defect: “He looked familiar with it” is unnatural and can suggest that Taekyung himself looked recognizable rather than accustomed to confronting such monsters.
findings.rationale: 익숙해 보였다 means that Taekyung appeared accustomed to the situation; 백전노장 evokes an experienced veteran, not necessarily someone who literally fought multiple wars.
findings.replacement: *Natural courage? That may be part of it, but there was something else… Yes. He looked used to it. Like a battle-hardened veteran who had fought countless battles.*
findings.source: ‘타고난 담력? 그럴 수도 있겠지만 무언가…… 그래, 익숙해 보였다. 마치 닳고 닳은 백전노장처럼.’

summary: Two critical subject and hierarchy errors, two major omissions affecting secrecy and execution details, and one minor wording defect.
